item.title: Trump announces at a Georgia campaign rally that Audi will build a new auto factory in the state
item.description: President Donald Trump has announced that Audi will build a new auto factory in Georgia. The Republican president's announcement Saturday at a campaign rally comes as he tries to deliver on his promise to bolster American manufacturing in the final days before the Nov. 3 midterm elections.

item.title: Sullivan, Peltola seek support from Alaska Native voters ahead of crucial Senate race
item.description: The major candidates in Alaska’s U.S. Senate race are both casting themselves as strong voices on Alaska Native issues as they seek support from the key constituency ahead of the Nov. 3 election.

item.title: New York's archdiocese and survivors of clergy abuse agree to $800 million legal settlement
item.description: The Archdiocese of New York and attorneys for about 1,300 parishioners who say they were sexually abused by clergy have agreed to an $800 million settlement of their legal claims.
